messages:
janet_cust_success: Customer reported repeated 504s on POST /v1/generate. UI timeouts started ~09:12 UTC, ticket#98721. They attached client trace and a short sample payload.
maria_support: Filed ticket, added headers: x-customer-id=acme, x-client-version=2.4.3. They said stream=false and many parallel short requests.
jamal_oncall: Investigating. Quick look at gateway metrics shows the tenant queue near capacity and continuous-batcher backlog rising. Pulling traces now.
jamal_oncall: Top-level logs snapshot:
```
gateway.enq_depth tenant=acme value=1024 max=1200
batcher.pending_batches=87 kv_cache_miss_pct=72 dequeue_latency_ms.p95=1800
```
ci-bot: deploy r1723 -> prod completed at 09:03 UTC.
rachel_sre: Looks like kvcache thrash + high miss rate. Is traffic pattern long-seq or high fanout small prompts?
maria_support: Customer says many short requests with effectively random prefixes (no reuse). High concurrency from client side.
alex_infra: Node-level metrics: GPU usage low, CPU and network normal. Bottleneck appears in dequeue and batching path (software).
jamal_oncall: Repro locally with a short-seq workload to simulate many independent prefixes. Repro command and pattern attached. Immediate mitigations recommended: apply tenant-level rate-limit, enable prefix caching feature flag for the tenant, and fall back to a smaller model variant for the spike.
rachel_sre: Applying mitigations: added soft throttle for tenant=acme to 30 rps and toggled acme-prefix-cache=true (feature-flag).
alex_infra: Temporarily increased gateway queue max_depth from 1200 -> 1600 for the affected gateway pool to buy headroom. Watching for regressions.
maria_support: Informed customer about temporary throttling and prefix caching. They report 504s dropped significantly but p95 still ~3s on some requests.
jamal_oncall: Next steps: capture detailed kvcache traces and histograms, collect per-batcher dequeue latencies, and check continuous-batcher eviction behavior. If persists, create full incident postmortem. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/queue-tail
rachel_sre: Quick repro tools:
```
wrk -t4 -c200 -d30s --latency http://gateway.internal/v1/generate -s scripts/short-req.lua
```
jamal_oncall: Plan: add eviction backoff and tweak batch_size/dequeue window for continuous-batcher; instrument kvcache warmup to reduce cold-miss storms. Will coordinate a config roll.
maria_support: Customer ok for now, monitoring under ticket#98721. :thumbsup:
ci-bot: incident created INC-2026-345, pagerduty notified.
alex_infra: Follow-up item: schedule config change to improve kvcache warming and add tenant-adaptive queueing to avoid single-tenant spike taking pool.
jamal_oncall: Marking thread for follow-up and possible postmortem if recurrence. Will update ticket and add traces to the incident.
